# MyDigitSign

> Free online PDF signer & digital signature tool. 100% browser-based — your files never leave your device.

## About

MyDigitSign is a free, privacy-first PDF signing tool that runs entirely in the browser. No server uploads, no account required, no subscriptions. Users can draw, type, or upload signatures and place them on PDF documents or images.

## Core USP: Files Never Leave Your Browser

Unlike DocuSign, Adobe Sign, SmallPDF, HelloSign, and other tools that upload your documents to cloud servers, MyDigitSign processes everything using WebAssembly and JavaScript locally in your browser. Zero server contact. Zero data breach risk from us.

## Key Features

- Sign PDFs and images (PNG, JPG) online for free
- 100% client-side processing — files never leave the user's device
- Draw signature with mouse or touchscreen
- Type signature in cursive fonts (Dancing Script, Pacifico, Great Vibes, Caveat)
- Upload existing signature image
- Drag, resize, and position signatures on any page
- Compress PDF — reduce file size 30–75%
- Merge PDF — combine multiple PDFs into one
- Rotate PDF — fix sideways or upside-down pages
- Protect PDF — AES-256 password encryption
- Split PDF — extract specific pages
- PDF to JPG — convert PDF pages to images
- JPG to PDF — convert images to PDF documents
- Sign Word Documents — add signatures to .docx files
- Download signed documents instantly
- No account or registration required
- Supports files up to 50MB
- Legally compliant with ESIGN Act (USA) and eIDAS (EU)
